description: Coherence metrics: Shannon entropy, mutual information, and replayable coherence passports. Computes module-level entropy, joint entropy, and mutual information from discretized numeric observations. Builds and validates coherence passports with SHA-256 hash chains. All claims: LOCAL_LAB_ONLY — not external proof.
function: Information theory (entropy, MI), coherence passport building and validation

inputs.name: discrete
inputs.description: Sequence of discrete symbol indices for shannon_entropy

inputs.name: x
inputs.description: First discrete sequence for joint_entropy or mutual_information

inputs.name: y
inputs.description: Second discrete sequence for joint_entropy or mutual_information

inputs.name: module_observations
inputs.description: Raw module observations for normalize_observations or build_coherence_passport

inputs.name: previous_hash
inputs.description: Hash of previous passport for chain linkage

inputs.name: passport
inputs.description: Coherence passport dict for seal_passport_hashes or validate_coherence_passport

inputs.name: tolerance
inputs.description: Floating point tolerance for formula verification (default: 1e-9)

outputs.name: mutual_information
outputs.description: Mutual information I(X;Y) clipped to [0, inf)

outputs.name: compute_metric_fields
outputs.description: Entropy, MI matrix, coherence, inter-variance fields

outputs.name: normalize_observations
outputs.description: Normalized dict, blockers list, warnings list

outputs.name: build_coherence_passport
outputs.description: Coherence passport with all metric fields and status

outputs.name: seal_passport_hashes
outputs.description: Passport copy with raw_payload_hash and entry_hash filled

outputs.name: validate_coherence_passport
outputs.description: Validation report with verdict, errors, and replay status

public_api.name: shannon_entropy
public_api.description: Shannon entropy H(X) in bits from a sequence of discrete symbols.

public_api.name: mutual_information
public_api.description: Mutual information I(X;Y) = H(X) + H(Y) - H(X,Y), clipped to [0, inf).

public_api.name: global_coherence
public_api.description: C(S) = I_mutual(S) / H_total(S); returns 0 if h_total == 0.

public_api.name: digitize
public_api.description: Bin continuous values into discrete integer indices in [0, bins-1].

public_api.name: compute_metric_fields
public_api.signature: compute_metric_fields(observations: Dict[str, List[float]], bins: int = 8) -> Dict[str, Any]
public_api.description: Compute entropy, mutual information matrix, and global coherence from module observations.

public_api.name: normalize_observations
public_api.description: Validate and normalize module_observations into float lists. Returns (normalized_dict, blockers, warnings).

public_api.name: build_coherence_passport
public_api.signature: build_coherence_passport(cycle_id, module_observations, *, system_version='LOCAL_CAPTURE', previous_hash=None, bins=8, meta=None) -> Dict
public_api.description: Build a coherence passport from raw module observations. Hashes are unsealed; call seal_passport_hashes() before replay.

public_api.name: seal_passport_hashes
public_api.description: Fill raw_payload_hash and entry_hash in a passport copy.

public_api.name: validate_coherence_passport
public_api.description: Validate a sealed coherence passport. Returns a report dict with verdict, errors, and replay status.
